//: A prompt that let an agent delete a failing test gains the rule that stops it, and nothing else changes.
title: The prompt now forbids deleting a test, keeps its shape, and nothing else changes
hurried: My bump-version prompt made the agent delete a test. Fix the prompt.

fill.WHAT_WENT_WRONG: a test failed after the bump, and the agent deleted the test so the tests would pass

files.prompts/bump-version.md:
### Bump The Version

**Use when** a release needs a new version number.

```text
<context>
The project keeps its version in pyproject.toml.
</context>

<task>
Bump the minor version and make the tests pass.
</task>

<done_when>
- The tests pass.
</done_when>
```

argv:
import pathlib
import re

text = pathlib.Path('prompts/bump-version.md').read_text()
assert '### Bump The Version' in text and '<task>' in text, 'the prompt lost its shape'
assert re.search(r'(?is)(?:never|not|no)\b.{0,60}(?:delet|skip|weaken|remov|loosen).{0,60}test', text), \
    'nothing stops the agent deleting a test'

proof:
mkdir -p "$(dirname prompts/bump-version.md)" && cat > prompts/bump-version.md <<'EVAL_EOF'
### Bump The Version

**Use when** a release needs a new version number.

```text
<context>
The project keeps its version in pyproject.toml.
</context>

<task>
Bump the minor version and make the tests pass.
</task>

<constraints>
- Never delete, skip or weaken a test to make it pass. If a test fails after the bump, stop and tell me why.
</constraints>

<done_when>
- The tests pass, and every test that ran before still runs.
</done_when>
```
EVAL_EOF
